sampling.priority: Clean common-observation targets first; round robin; point-identity hash order
sampling.estimator: fixed stratified sample ratio: sum(n_h/m_h * I*T) / sum(n_h/m_h * I); sampled approximation

decision.status: preregistered project heuristics; uncalibrated practical margins, not detector or power claims

frame_selection.distance: inclusive XY Euclidean; identical to frozen coordinate audit
frame_selection.validation_rule: retain original seeded block when admissible; otherwise first admissible adjacent block in cyclic start-index order anchored at original start
frame_selection.development_rule: preserve P6 frames; hard stop if inadmissible
frame_selection.scene_rule: preserve original eight P7 scene identities; no substitute scenes; if any has no admissible pair, all independent validation is unavailable
frame_selection.evidence: Clean lidar_pose and timestamp identities only; never PCD, GT visibility, weather, signal metrics or AP
frame_selection.timing: new protocol revision fixed after v1 P7-0 failure, before v2 weather integration; full prior validation outcomes not provided
